title: Berezutskaya2022 film speech versus music
input_description: Independent, shuffled 2-second iEEG windows from good ECoG and sEEG channels, resampled within each window to 256 Hz. A participant has a stable local montage; the sample input has no movie time or block order.
output_description: One probability of the speech condition for each opaque window ID. The evaluator averages probabilities by hidden movie block before scoring.
native_split_description: A new BrainPilotBench protocol, not a source-native machine-learning split: global movie blocks 1,3,6,7,8,10,13 train; 4,11 validation; 2,5,9,12 evaluator-only Test. The same split applies to every eligible iEEG participant. Training and prediction are within participant.
